hooks.command: bash -c 'if [[ "{{file}}" == *".env"* ]]; then echo "❌ Blocked: .env files should not be edited. Use .env.example instead."; exit 1; fi'

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; root="$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && pwd)"; case "$f" in "$root"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -d "$root/node_modules" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */app/*.ts|*/app/*.tsx) root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -d "$root/node_modules" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty -p app/tsconfig.json;; esac; }
